profile.notes: Undergraduate, expected graduation 2029 (second-year in the 2026-27 academic year).

programs.name: FOCUS (NYC)
programs.eligibility_note: Jane Street describes FOCUS as a program for first-year university students who faced barriers to advanced STEM access.

programs.name: INSIGHT (NYC)
programs.eligibility_note: For women, transgender and gender-expansive undergraduates. Three tracks: Trading & Research, Software Engineering, Strategy & Product.

programs.name: Bridge
programs.eligibility_note: Day-long program for first- and second-year university students.

programs.name: FutureFocus (Chicago)
programs.eligibility_note: Five-day program with Technology and Quantitative Trading & Research tracks. The 2027 Amsterdam edition targets students graduating in 2029; the US edition has historically been posted around December-January for a late-March program.

programs.name: Explore HRT (NYC)
programs.eligibility_note: Multi-day spring program for students interested in quantitative trading. The last cycle targeted 2028 graduates, so the 2027 cycle may target 2028 or 2029 graduates. Check the posting.

programs.name: Inside HRT (NYC)
programs.eligibility_note: Three-day spring program for first- and second-year students in CS, math or other STEM fields with little prior exposure to quant finance.

programs.name: Launchpad (Chicago)
programs.eligibility_note: Two-day Chicago program for second-year students (penultimate year in the following summer). Quant Trading and Software Engineering tracks.

programs.name: ASDI / STEP Internship (US)
programs.eligibility_note: Google's first/second-year program formerly called STEP now appears on Google Careers as 'Associate Software Developer Intern' (ASDI). Summer 2027 US posting was not up as of late October 2026.

programs.name: Discover Citadel (US)
programs.eligibility_note: First- or second-year undergraduates (December 2028 to June 2030 graduation). US and Canada students are considered for the New York event only.

programs.name: Discover Citadel Securities (US)
programs.eligibility_note: Same format as Discover Citadel: first- or second-year undergraduates graduating December 2028 to June 2030.

programs.name: Fellowships (Discovery / Latitude / Nexus / Momentum)
programs.eligibility_note: Three-day NYC fellowships. Discovery and Latitude have targeted second-year undergraduates; Nexus has targeted rising juniors. As of October 2026 the campus site lists no US fellowship, only a closed London Insight Programme.

programs.name: New Seekers Summit
programs.eligibility_note: For first- and second-year undergraduates interested in quantitative research and data science. Historically announced in the fall with a November deadline.
